text:
Sam M.: quick one — we need to lock the customer story assets for Orchid launch this week. call has recording, but we still need final quote + 30s clip for socials.
Ivy (CS): got the recording, uploaded to GDrive here: https://drive.google.com/example — I timestamped the best soundbites at 02:18, 05:10, 09:40.
Ken (Sales): thanks Ivy. the quote we want in the hero: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~4x while keeping p95 latency stable" — is that ok to attribute to Orchid?
Julia (Legal): need written sign-off from their comms person before publishing any quoted attribution. also want to run the final short-form copy through our release checklist.
Maria G.: can we share a short list of options for the customer to pick from? makes approvals faster. I can draft 3 headline variations and a 30s caption.
Sam M.: yes please. Maria, two constraints: keep technical claim as-is but add a small hedge: "~4x cost reduction on our workload". Also include a non-technical version for executive channels.
Maria G.: drafting now. first pass: 
1) "Orchid speeds up development: 4x inference cost reduction with Redwood"
2) "Orchid scales inference affordably — p95 latency kept under 120ms"
3) "Orchid + Redwood = lower cost, same latency (4x cost savings)"
Caption (30s): "Orchid cut inference spend by ~4x after moving to Redwood Inference, keeping fast response times for customers. Watch how they did it. [link] #mlops #inference"
Ken (Sales): option 1 is nice for focus on dev velocity. option 2 reads too much like a benchmark. customer prefers plain numbers though.
Ivy (CS): tagging their comms lead @Lina — Lina, quick question: would Orchid sign the short approved quote: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~4x while maintaining p95 latency"? we can offer the non-technical alternative too.
Julia (Legal): also request a quick email thread from Orchid saying who can approve quotes and any Do-Not-Publish items. we can't proceed without that.
Maria G.: for the 30s social clip — do we want a customer-led soundbite or a narrator? Customer's audio is clean at 02:18 but short. Could stitch with product B-roll.
Sam M.: go with customer-led + B-roll. make a 30s edit: 0-6s visual intro, 6-20s customer quote, 20-30s CTA with logo/link.
Ivy (CS): Lina replied in DM: she can approve quotes, expecting the caption and headline by EOD. she also flagged a compliance note: no mention of competitor names and no raw usage numbers beyond %s.
Maria G.: adjusting copy. new headline option: "Orchid reduces inference costs by ~4x with Redwood" (removes 'cut' language). Caption tweaked to avoid raw tokens.
Ken (Sales): pipeline note — can we add a short CTA in the caption for inbound leads: "Book a demo to see your expected savings"? that helps routing.
Sam M.: yes, add CTA but keep it subtle. Maria, include a UTM in the link for inbound lead routing: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=orchid_launch.
Maria G.: done. final caption draft: "Orchid reduced inference costs by ~4x after moving to Redwood Inference while keeping fast response times. See how — book a demo: redwood.com/demo?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=orchid_launch #mlops"
Julia (Legal): I can sign off on that caption once we have written approval from Lina and confirmation there's no embargo. also want to review the short video script (voiceover + on-screen text) — attach when ready.
Ivy (CS): Lina emailed approval for the wording above and confirmed no embargo. attaching her OK: "Lina A. (Orchid) — approved for publication: headline + caption + 30s edit"
Sam M.: great — Maria, proceed to build the 30s edit and two social image variants. Tag me when uploaded so I can schedule in Sprout.
Maria G.: uploading drafts now to drive: https://drive.google.com/draft-orchid. I added a version with captions and one without.
Ken (Sales): I'll prep a short sales enable note for SDRs so inbound demo requests get routed: one-pager + template reply.
Sam M.: action items: Maria — finalize edit & images; Ken — SDR note; Julia — legal stamp once video script attached; Ivy — confirm Lina's sign-off included in folder. Target publish: Thursday 09:00 PT.
Maria G.: noted, aiming to finalize by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:
Julia (Legal): will do quick check on script within 2 hours after upload.
Ivy (CS): confirmed Lina's approval is in the folder. good to go from CS.
Sam M.: thanks team — will schedule and send the launch playbook after assets are final.
Maria G.: uploaded final mp4 + screenshots. shared link in thread.
Julia (Legal): reviewed script and stamp: APPROVED.
Ken (Sales): SDR note uploaded, includes email templates and routing tags.
Sam M.: closing the loop — publish scheduled, demo routing live, and we have the quote cleared. great work. :rocket:
